name: netw5
description: The MACRAW driver on the host's real network (NOT in the gate: a real DHCP server and LAN traffic). The release /etc/rc is staged back so /etc/netstart takes a lease, then the network modules load and the driver attaches over what DHCP left in the chip. Only means anything at kernel.netprobe = 1.
command: /testbin/ifcprobe; modload bsdnetd bsdnet0 bsdnet1 bsdnet2 bsdnet3; sleep 50; dmesg | tail -14

requires.reason: the probe C is compiled into the network modules only at kernel.netprobe = 1
